methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i archive.rmvb -c:v libx264 -c:a aac archive.mp4.
methods.limits: Requires RealMedia demuxing, the RealVideo decoder, AAC, and libx264 in the installed build.

methods.steps: Select Media > Convert/Save, click Add, choose the RMVB and click Open, type a destination file name, choose a conversion profile that outputs MP4 and click Start.
methods.limits: The documentation does not list the available profiles; choose one that outputs MP4.

methods.steps: Run magick -density 300 logo.svg logo-print.tiff.
methods.limits: The -density option sets the canvas resolution while rendering SVG; renderer selection can affect appearance.

methods.steps: Open the SVG as an image, choose File > Export As to store it in a format other than XCF, and pick TIFF; the TIFF dialog offers the compression options.
methods.limits: Renders vectors to pixels; check fonts, profiles, and export options.

methods.steps: Run ffdec -format frame:gif -export frame frames-out banner.swf, using the platform-specific executable.
methods.limits: The documented -format pre-option selects GIF for frame export, which gives individual frame images; review unsupported effects or script-driven appearance.

methods.steps: For decodable embedded video, run ffmpeg -i clip.swf flash-preview.gif.
methods.limits: The SWF demuxer reads bitmap, video and audio data and skips unknown tags; it is not a complete vector/ActionScript renderer.

methods.steps: Play a compatible SWF in Ruffle; in OBS add a window or display capture source, click Start Recording and perform the sequence; encode the saved recording as GIF with FFmpeg.
methods.limits: Captures the particular playback session and its errors; Ruffle compatibility varies; extra render/encode generation.

methods.steps: In GIMP choose File > Export As (Shift+Ctrl+E) to store the TIFF as PNG. In Inkscape import the PNG with File > Import, select it with the Selector tool, open Path > Trace Bitmap, adjust the options, update the preview and apply the trace.
methods.limits: Tracing approximates image regions; the vector result is positioned exactly above the picture, so the original stays underneath until it is moved or deleted.

methods.steps: Run magick scan.tiff scan.bmp, then potrace -s scan.bmp -o scan-outline.svg.
methods.limits: Potrace does not list TIFF input; it reads PBM, PGM, PPM and BMP, converts other pixels to black and white with a threshold, and does not keep continuous tones.

methods.steps: Run magick display-face.ttf display-face-preview.png.
methods.limits: The TTF reader returns a preview and requires FreeType support; it is not a full glyph sheet.

methods.steps: Load the font with ImageFont.truetype; create an image with Image.new; draw the sample text with ImageDraw.text and the loaded font; call save with a .png file name.
methods.limits: Requires a script, explicit canvas bounds and selected sample; a PNG has no reusable font tables.

methods.steps: With the typeface available in the font selector, create an image, choose the Text tool, pick the font and size, type the sample, then choose File > Export As and pick PNG.
methods.limits: This is a manually composed sample of an available font, not direct import of TTF as an image or an automatic atlas.

methods.steps: Create an image; choose the Text tool; enable the editor window and use its folder icon to load the TXT; pick the font and size and drag a text frame; File > Export As and choose JPEG.
methods.limits: Proofread encoding and clipping; text outside the canvas is not preserved as an editable JPG object.

methods.steps: Run magick -background white -fill black -pointsize 24 -size 800x caption:@notes.txt notes-card.jpg.
methods.limits: The caption: operator word-wraps to the -size width and -font picks the typeface; a local security policy may restrict indirect @file reads; inspect wrapping.

methods.steps: Read TXT with the correct encoding, create a canvas using Image.new (default color black, so pass white), draw lines with ImageDraw.multiline_text and a font, and save with a .jpg name.
methods.limits: Requires custom sizing, measurement, and wrapping/pagination choices.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i session.wav -vn -c:a aac -b:a 192k session-listen.aac.
methods.limits: AAC encoder required; specify channel/rate settings explicitly for a fixed delivery specification.

methods.steps: Open the WAV; File > Export Audio; select Custom FFmpeg Export; open the format options and choose a format and an AAC codec; export.
methods.limits: The optional FFmpeg library is needed; the formats and codecs offered depend on how FFmpeg was built.

methods.steps: Open the WAV; File > Save As; choose AAC.
methods.limits: AAC writing is listed for Windows and Mac; avoid repeated lossy editing generations.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i cue.wav -t 30 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -vn -f ipod cue-tone.m4r.
methods.limits: This desktop example explicitly trims at 30 seconds; it does not install or assign a ringtone.

methods.steps: Open the WAV; File > Save As; choose M4R.
methods.limits: NCH lists M4R saving as Windows-only.

methods.steps: Create a recording project; Tracks > Loops Browser > Files > Browse items from Files; bring WAV into Tracks, trim; My Songs, select project, Share > Ringtone > Export.
methods.limits: Creates and installs a device ringtone rather than a separate M4R file download; 30-second ringtone limit, and GarageBand offers to shorten a longer export.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i legacy.wmv -c:v mpeg4 -c:a libmp3lame legacy.avi.
methods.limits: Installed build must have the input decoder and the requested encoders; this re-encodes the streams instead of copying them.

methods.steps: Open the XCF; File > Export As (Shift+Ctrl+E); export as PDF; the PDF dialog has options such as Layers as pages and Fill transparent areas with background color.
methods.limits: Layers as pages is optional.

methods.steps: Run magick project.xcf project-review.pdf.
methods.limits: The formats page lists XCF as read-only and says PDF output needs Ghostscript installed.

methods.steps: Export the intended composition from GIMP as PNG, open the PNG in Preview, then File > Export > Format PDF and Save.
methods.limits: Preview operates on the PNG intermediate, not directly on the XCF project.
